# SimpleX general terms, version 2

These terms apply to every .simplex name that is not on the list of bona fide
community names. You accept them when you register or receive a name.

## Use

A name points to the SimpleX addresses its holder sets. The holder must not use
it to impersonate anyone, to mislead its users or to send unsolicited messages.

## Term

Registering or receiving a name gives you its use until it expires. A transfer
passes on the remaining term, not more.
